observedEarlierFailures.finding: Old OFF assertion required hidden Project UI. New normal product shows unavailable UI with inert write controls. Replaced with visible/inert/studio_off plus unchanged local/Cloud assertions.
Studio owner mirrors and Chord URLs still referenced pre-198 releases. Updated to the independently declared app versions; 288 Node checks pass.

One Chromium repeat stopped at pro-required while entering NEWS; cause remains unconfirmed. WebKit synthetic microphone waits stopped intermittently when tuner navigation was invoked by evaluate without a user gesture. Real menu clicks retain identical stream-start and stop assertions; the corrected run passed 35 checks. This supports an autoplay-fixture hypothesis, not a real microphone PASS.
